comments.body: Hi! Gentle ping in case this slipped through — it still merges cleanly with main. Happy to adjust anything if you'd prefer a different approach. Thanks for maintaining this!

Thanks for the review. The branch now includes current main via a merge, so the original commit is unchanged and this can be pushed without rewriting history. `inferenceConfig` calls `ModelAcceptsSamplingParams` only when the model id contains `anthropic.claude`, which covers the base ids and the regional inference profiles. `TestSampling_KeptForOtherModels` now also checks `us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0`. `go test ./internal/plugins/ai/bedrock` passes.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
